info.title: pi-agent-server host API
info.description:
Fixed host API contract v1. Dynamic plugin routes are not part of this document.
Request validation semantics: Request bodies use Fastify's AJV baseline: declared types are coerced (`coerceTypes: 'array'`,
so numbers, booleans, and single-element arrays are accepted where a string is declared) and
undeclared fields are silently stripped (`removeAdditional: true` combined with
`additionalProperties: false`) instead of returning 400. A 400 therefore reports a missing
required field or a value that cannot be coerced/constrained, never a wrong scalar type or an
unknown field.

code.description: A model-failback continuation owns this request; retry abort after its end event.

post.description:
The abort body is parsed by a hand-written strict validator, not by AJV: an absent body is
accepted, but a supplied body must contain exactly the `requestId` field with a string value.
Unknown fields and non-string values are rejected with 400 (no type coercion, no silent
stripping).

200.description: SSE stream. Each `data:` line is a SseEvent JSON value.

X-Server-Epoch.description: Present when the server epoch is configured.

204.description: Viewer may receive this when the owned session has no live runtime; no stream is created.

500.description: Session events could not be started.

IpAdmission.description: Mandatory direct-peer CIDR/IP admission. This is evaluated by the host, not supplied by a client.

BearerAuth.description: Required only when the admitted IP profile has tokenRequired=true.

code.description: Fastify validation error code when applicable.

id.description: Preserved legacy host message id, if any.

sourceId.description: Pi JSONL message-entry id. When present, exactly matches timeline.messageId; image-only messages have one too.

messages.description: Legacy message projection. Pi transcripts include sourceId; no text-based timeline association is permitted.

timeline.description: Current-branch, block-ordered history. Thinking is never exported; tool text/JSON is not host-truncated.

callId.description: SDK tool-call id; use as the SSE deduplication key.
